rotating_reviews: “I was a complete beginner on a snowboard and made great progress after just three hours with Basil's help.” Marigona Sejdiu Full review

“I’ve never skiied or snowboarded in my life and Basil was the perfect instructor!! He’s very patient, explains things very well and I felt 100% safe with him going straight to a blue run.” Charleigh Full review
“Basil is an excellent and patient snowboard instructor and has built a really cool snowboard school. Definitely recommended for anyone who has snowboarding on their bucket list ☺️🙌” Selina Flühler
“My sons learned a lot and had so much fun snowboarding that they didn't want to stop.” Julio Pinto Full review
“The whole session was fun, motivating, and super effective — you can tell he's a very experienced and passionate instructor.” Ryan Padley Full review

“We had such a fantastic experience with Basil at Bluebird in Engelberg! He taught my three kids over three days, and I honestly couldn’t have asked for a better instructor.” Hans NorthRider Full review

“Basil was extremely patient and, with his support, quickly got me up to speed. After a few corrections and some runs, I was able to improve my skills enormously in just a few days.” liam rohner Full review
“Basil is a super cool guy with tons of experience. He really knows how to shred the slopes and explain things in a clear, motivating way.” Sacha Meier Full review
